The escalation of 10.2 counts failures for one task, and the harness
adapters mint a fresh task id per tool call, so no streak can accrue on
that path. The amendment defines the unit (the tool call), the scope (the
session, plus an actor-scoped backstop the party under oversight cannot
rotate), the completion counterpart that supplies the missing failure
signal, the bound invariant 4 places on a self-reported outcome, and the
remedy, which stays manual rather than refused.

Design only, flagged pending sign-off. AC1 of APRV-145; AC2 is unbuilt
and waits on the human decision, including how the counterpart reconciles
with the execution-delegated refusal in the open PR #145 (APRV-146).
